mapper.select: SELECT u.uid,u.user_name,u.real_name,u.mobile,u.last_login_time,u.is_deleted,u.last_login_ip, u.login_count,u.create_time,u.update_time,u.user_account,u.email,u.head_icon,u.user_state FROM sys_user_info u INNER JOIN sys_user_third t ON t.user_id=u.uid WHERE t.third_union_id=#{params.thirdPartyUnionId} AND t.third_party_type=#{params.thirdPartyType} and t.is_deleted = false and u.is_deleted = false
SELECT u.uid AS userId, u.user_name, u.real_name, u.mobile, u.code FROM sys_user_info u INNER JOIN sys_user_third t ON t.user_id=u.uid WHERE u.is_deleted = false

SELECT id, user_id, third_party_type, third_union_id, third_open_id, third_user_id, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user_third WHERE third_party_type = #{platform} and ( third_open_id = #{thirdId} OR third_user_id = #{thirdId} OR third_union_id = #{thirdId} ) LIMIT 1
